thesis: Conceptual elegance preserves distinctions and enables inquiry without hiding differences or immunizing theories against failure.

ideas.statement: A good concept discriminates; total explanations and automatic cynical unmasking can seduce by eliminating possible counterevidence.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Distinctions specify relationships rather than sealed separations; excessive complexity or indefinite subtlety are no guarantees of understanding.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Distinctions specify relationships rather than sealed separations; excessive complexity or indefinite subtlety are no guarantees of understanding.
